cues: The famous one: Mimosa pudica, lajjawati.
An electrical signal races through the leaf, and within seconds the leaflets fold together in pairs, and then the whole leaf droops.
text: The famous one: Mimosa pudica, lajjawati. Touch one leaflet. An electrical signal races through the leaf, and within seconds the leaflets fold together in pairs, and then the whole leaf droops.
